# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository. Apply any more specific `AGENTS.md` in the affected path. That file contains the project rules, verification commands, approval gates and skill or memory entry points.

Load project workflows from `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Use the current client's tools and model roles as described in `AGENTS.md`. If a required local dependency, browser or review capability is unavailable, report the limitation before the dependent step.
